title: Constellation Completes Calpine Transaction, Powering America's Clean Energy Future - Calpine
text:
Constellation Completes Calpine Transaction, Powering America's Clean Energy Future - Calpine 
 News 
 Constellation Completes Calpine Transaction, Powering America’s Clean Energy Future 
 January 7, 2026 
 Combination brings together premier nuclear, natural gas and geothermal fleets with a leading commercial platform to deliver innovative customer solutions and strengthen U.S. energy leadership, national security and economic prosperity. 
 Click here to read the official press release.

raw.clue: Constellation Energy 通过收购 Calpine 实现了业务组合，这可能会增加其收入来源。
raw.quote: Combination brings together premier nuclear, natural gas and geothermal fleets with a leading commercial platform to deliver innovative customer solutions and strengthen U.S. energy leadership, national security and economic prosperity.

raw.clue: Constellation Energy 的收购行为旨在提供创新的客户解决方案，这可能会吸引更多客户，从而增加收入。
raw.quote: to deliver innovative customer solutions and strengthen U.S. energy leadership, national security and economic prosperity.

raw.clue: 通过收购 Calpine，Constellation Energy 加强了其在美国能源领导地位，这可能有助于其收入的增长。
raw.quote: strengthen U.S. energy leadership, national security and economic prosperity.
